target: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
scope: read-only backend and SQLite design review; BE3-1..10 closure and new conflicts

findings.title: Planner execution ordering remains contradictory
findings.recommendation: Make the transaction-external sequence the single contract and remove stale opposite ordering statements.

findings.title: Nickname validation conflicts with committed receipt replay
findings.recommendation: Authorize current owner, check receipt and replay before comparing nickname; compare only on receipt misses/new planning.

findings.title: Bundle cache key hides same-command fingerprint conflicts
findings.recommendation: Key by lesson_id+command_id and compare fingerprint on hit.

findings.title: Store build-tag placement cannot construct API-private task context
findings.recommendation: Keep coordinator/contracts in store; put pilot adapter in api package under the tag; compose in harness.

findings.title: Unknown commit wording permits storage without rollback proof
findings.recommendation: Permit write retry only with original bundle and explicit rollback-proven outcome from original connection; otherwise read-only pending_unknown.

findings.title: Per-request planner injection does not guarantee cross-request cache ownership
findings.recommendation: Use one case-scoped long-lived coordinator/planner; fail closed on cache capacity rather than evict unresolved entries.

findings.title: Sidecar restart recovery and corruption behavior are underspecified
findings.recommendation: Specify persistent case directory/key, strict replay and fail-closed behavior for truncated, contradictory, duplicate, or missing sidecar data.

findings.title: rollback_proven terminal state is confused with in-process same-ID retry permission
findings.recommendation: After restart with bundle lost, reject same command permanently and require a new ID; only a live retained bundle may be retried.

findings.title: Mixed lifecycle audit must preserve existing legacy and FK audit passes
findings.recommendation: Reuse loadPilotLegacyBridgesTx, auditPilotLegacyRuntimeTx, FK checks and bridge validation; replace only global created-only assumption with per-lesson dispatch.

findings.title: Audit-to-receipt association is not fully specified by current schema
findings.recommendation: Freeze deterministic trace/tool/effect mapping and duplicate/orphan rejection across mixed lifecycle rows.

findings.title: Ordinal scope is ambiguous across multiple students
findings.recommendation: Define ordinal per student and ensure one student's first reservation does not affect another's ordinal.

required_before_implementation: Fix cache ownership, key, and conflict semantics.
Separate store coordinator contracts from api-private task/tool adapter.
Define sidecar lifecycle and explicit rollback-proof result propagation.
Complete mixed audit facade, legacy/FK preservation, and audit-receipt association contracts.
